I currently have one 290X [4GB] and have my resolution set at 3200x1800 60Hz thanks to VSR. I'm wondering if 4GB would be enough for newer titles (current/feature releases) for gaming at my set resolution. I could pick up another 290X a lot cheaper than buying a brand new card with more VRAM. Is 4GB really good enough for 4K gaming at max settings with newer titles? The last game I bought was BF4 and can get an average of 90FPS with my current setup.
4k gaming and VRAM needed for new titles

The most recent AAA games might get close to the limit if you are running on the max texture settings at 4k. I personally have a 970, and with the games I've tried with 4k DSR, I've never hit the 4 (3.5) GB cap. The newest game I tried was Arkham Origins, and it ran fine on the max texture settings.

Also remember that currently SLI/Crossfire mirrors the VRAM across the cards, so getting another 290x won't give you 8GB. Your game will most likely run at a much higher FPS anyway, though.

I can't imagine it would use it all, yes it may be pushing it if you want to play the lastest AAA max settings with things like AA on. From what i've seen from benchmarks to 290X is more than capable to play at 4K.

These are actually good movies, but also not good like Jurassic Park or Drive or Big Lebowski or any other legitimate good movie. They are self aware, but not in a manner that they use that as an excuse to ham it up. And they also don't tend have any camera-winks which is fantastic.
